items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: he was bucking Frank Sebastian next door

ctx.x: I stayed with Leon from June to the holidays. We worked at the open air dance until it closed, then we went out to Spie'Iman's Nightingale (phonetic spelling) in Culver City. It had been closed and he
tried to reopen it and we went to the re-opening because he was bucking Frank Sebastian next door, and he had Miss Carolyn Snowden's review.
I think Miss Snowden was an outstanding woman musician at that time?
